financial_invariant: Uncertain outcome never permits replacement or replay of a financial command.
time: Nonnegative monotonic caller-supplied tick. Repository overload uses admission-to-admission deadlines; pure finish can use completion time.
authentication: 401 or changed/unavailable session requires a new scope; no budget reset; original identity retained.
single_flight: One read/apply/cleanup scope per shared storage lock within one process. No timer steals a live lease. Released in finally.
budget_scope: Opt-in local controller; not durable or global; manual GET recovery remains possible. No automatic scheduler is enabled.
